title: Angiogram Stenosis Detection Using Computer Vision
summary: A computer-vision pipeline for coronary angiogram analysis that quantifies blockage severity from extracted vessel structure.
bullets: Built a computer vision pipeline for coronary angiogram analysis — vessel enhancement, artery structure extraction, stenosis detection — computing percentage diameter stenosis (%DS) to support objective assessment of blockage severity.
Validated outputs through visual inspection and quantitative comparison of segmented vessels against detected narrowing regions.
